issues.path: detail[*].detail_category (Operating expenses lines, e.g. detail[6], detail[120])
issues.issue: 'not itemized' is meant for a function/department total with no object breakdown. Here 'Operating expenses' is a generic object line inside an object breakdown, so this category is a judgment call (documented in notes).

issues.path: detail[*].detail_category (General Fund department Capital outlay lines, e.g. detail[55])
issues.issue: The page does not say whether department capital outlay is equipment or buildings. Mapping it to equipment purchases is an assumption (documented in notes).
